==Overview==
* Request for funds to be used to [[Casualties#Resupply|resupply]] the [[Army|Imperial armies]].

==Progress==
* Autumn 378YE, 400 Thrones disbursed to Orrick, Senator Bregasland
* Summer 378YE, 200 Thrones disbursed to Orrick, Senator Bregasland

==Autumn 378YE==
<ic>Motion to provide funds with the intention of resupplying the Imperial Armies, either though future motions or the Imperial Quartermaster.<br><br>''Proposed by Bregasland, seconded by Hahnmark''</ic>

==Summer 378YE==
<ic>To distribute funds to Bregasland with the intention of resupplying the armies. The Quartermaster General will be called as an expert witness.<br><br>''Proposed by Bregasland, seconded by Mitwold''</ic>
